class.name: OcgGCMakearcofhyperbola2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for arcs of hyperbolas in the plane. The result is a `Geom2d_TrimmedCurve`. A `GC_MakeArcOfHyperbola2d` object provides a framework for: - defining the construction parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the construction status and the resulting arc via `Value()`.
class.description: ! This class implements construction algorithms for arcs of hyperbolas in the plane. ! The result is a `Geom2d_TrimmedCurve`. ! A `GC_MakeArcOfHyperbola2d` object provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction parameters; ! - running the construction algorithm; ! - querying the construction status and the resulting arc via `Value()`. ! @note Angular parameters are expressed in radians.

method.name: from_gp_Hypr2d_const_ref_double_double_bool
method.description: Constructs an arc from angular bounds on a hyperbola.

method.name: from_gp_Hypr2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_double_bool
method.description: Constructs an arc from a point and angular bound on a hyperbola.

method.name: from_gp_Hypr2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_bool
method.description: Constructs an arc between two points on a hyperbola.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed arc of hyperbola.
